items.title: Americas Engineering & Construction_ GS Data Center Construction Spending Tracker_ Texas leads, new markets emerge

items.quote_zh: 資料中心營建支出在 6 月加速到年增 46%，折合年率 $68 bn，5 月為年增 32%；過去三個月支出增加約 18%（折合年率約 +90%）。

items.title: Americas Engineering & Construction_ GS Data Center Construction Spending Tracker_ Texas leads, new markets emerge
items.quote: The top five states by data center capacity under construction account for ~60% of total data centers being built, led by Virginia and Texas. Yet none of these five states rank among the five fastest growing states by project announcements as growth is increasingly occurring outside traditional markets.
items.quote_zh: 以在建資料中心容量計的前五大州，約佔全部在建資料中心的 60%，由維吉尼亞與德州領頭。然而這五州沒有一個進得了以專案宣布件數計的成長最快前五名，因為成長愈來愈發生在傳統市場之外。

items.title: Americas Engineering & Construction_ GS Data Center Construction Spending Tracker_ Texas leads, new markets emerge
items.quote: The key uncertainty in our view is timing rather than demand.
items.quote_zh: 我們認為關鍵的不確定性在時點，而不在需求。

items.title: Americas Engineering & Construction_ GS Data Center Construction Spending Tracker_ Texas leads, new markets emerge
items.quote: This month, Texas paused approvals for new data center grid interconnection requests while on August 18, 2026, Pennsylvania’s Governor signed Executive Order 2026-05, requiring data center developers to make legally binding commitments to compliance with the Governor’s Responsible Infrastructure Development (GRID) Requirements.
items.quote_zh: 本月德州暫停了新的資料中心併網申請核准；2026 年 8 月 18 日，賓州州長簽署 2026-05 號行政命令，要求資料中心開發商就遵循州長的「負責任基礎設施開發（GRID）」要求做出具法律拘束力的承諾。

items.title: Americas Engineering & Construction_ GS Data Center Construction Spending Tracker_ Texas leads, new markets emerge
items.quote: we believe EME offers the broadest exposure to major data center markets, FIX provides the greatest leverage to Texas and emerging markets through workforce mobility and fabrication, and LGN’s participation in higher-growth regions is increasingly driven by its fabrication platform rather than its local craft labor footprint.
items.quote_zh: 我們認為 EME 對主要資料中心市場的暴露最廣，FIX 透過工班機動性與預製，對德州及新興市場的槓桿最大，而 LGN 參與較高成長區域的能力，愈來愈是由其預製平台驅動，而非由其在地技術工班的足跡驅動。

items.quote_zh: 商業規劃較上月上升 4.1%、年增 13.8%，遠高於 2019 年水準，完全由資料中心帶動。扣掉這個垂直市場，該部門年減 16.2%，成因是高基期，以及傳統辦公大樓、倉儲、零售與旅館的下滑。

items.quote_zh: 考量產業自身的動能，我們預期醫療、運輸與教育會相對突出。由於這幾個部門約佔 AWI 銷售的 60%，加上更高的整修暴露與公司自身的計畫，我們維持對該股的正面看法。

items.title: US Rates Weekly Can Secretary Bessent and Chair Warsh save the curve?
items.quote: We got long 20y bonds after Treasury increased long-end buybacks this week.
items.quote_zh: 在財政部本週調高長端買回規模之後，我們做多了 20 年期公債。

items.title: US Rates Weekly Can Secretary Bessent and Chair Warsh save the curve?
items.quote: In our view a hawkish Fed would likely hinder rather than help our trade. We see little evidence that tighter Fed policy would transmit into lower and more stable long-end yields.
items.quote_zh: 我們認為鷹派的聯準會比較可能扯這筆交易的後腿，而不是幫上忙。我們幾乎看不到證據顯示更緊的聯準會政策會傳導成更低、更穩定的長端殖利率。

items.title: US Rates Weekly Can Secretary Bessent and Chair Warsh save the curve?
items.quote: We stay bearish on short-expiry vols and see room for the vol term structures to steepen further.
items.quote_zh: 我們維持看空短天期波動率，並認為波動率的期限結構還有繼續陡峭化的空間。

items.title: US Economics Weekly
items.quote: While many factors could be driving the increase in yields, we would note that recent macro fundamentals do not seem consistent with higher yields.
items.quote_zh: 雖然可能有許多因素在推升殖利率，但我們要指出，近期的總體基本面看起來與更高的殖利率並不一致。

items.title: US Economics Weekly
items.quote: While longer-end yields are not abnormally high compared to short-end yields across their history, the unexpected announcement does suggest a degree of discomfort with recent moves higher in yields.
items.quote_zh: 雖然以歷史來看，長端殖利率相對短端並沒有異常偏高，但這個未被預期的宣布，確實透露出對近期殖利率上行的某種不適。

items.title: US Economics Weekly
items.quote: Minutes of the July FOMC meeting felt stale in light of weaker employment and further slowing in inflation in data received after the meeting.
items.quote_zh: 對照會後收到的更疲弱就業與更進一步放緩的通膨資料，七月 FOMC 會議紀要讀起來已經過時。

items.title: US Economics Weekly
items.quote: And while investment related to AI-demand is a substantial driver of growth, not all this demand is boosting domestic production.
items.quote_zh: 而且，儘管與 AI 需求相關的投資是成長的重要驅動力，這些需求並非全部都在推升國內生產。

items.title: Global Asset Allocation
items.quote: To us that suggests a plausible stabilization of rates, and plausibly more, especially if we are correct on a more dovish Fed. We therefore cut our US underweight back to zero.
items.quote_zh: 對我們來說，這意味著利率有機會穩下來，甚至不只如此——尤其如果我們對聯準會會更鴿派這件事看對了。因此我們把美債的低配砍回零。

items.title: Global Asset Allocation
items.quote: From a cross-asset perspective, we continue to see greater downside risk in credit than in equities.
items.quote_zh: 從跨資產的角度看，我們仍然認為信用債的下檔風險大於股票。

items.title: Global Asset Allocation
items.quote: While we are overweight US equities and have been for a while, we have capacity to add risk. But we would prefer to do this on a pull-back.
items.quote_zh: 我們超配美股已經有一段時間了，而且還有加碼風險的空間。但我們寧可等一次回檔再動手。

items.title: Global Asset Allocation
items.quote: With the US Treasury aiming to control yields at the back end of the curve, investors will likely position for other debasement trades, instead of the steepener.
items.quote_zh: 既然美國財政部打算控制曲線長端的殖利率，投資人很可能會轉去布局其他的貨幣貶值交易，而不是做陡曲線。

items.title: Asia Insights
items.quote: Despite the recent surge in FDI approvals, we maintain our 2026-27 GDP growth forecasts at 1.8% and 2.0%, below our estimate of potential growth at around 2.4%.
items.quote_zh: 儘管近期 FDI 核准激增，我們仍維持 2026 至 2027 年 GDP 成長預估為 1.8% 與 2.0%，低於我們估計約 2.4% 的潛在成長率。

items.title: Asia Insights
items.quote: Data centers will likely deliver limited spillovers to the domestic economy, as they rely heavily on imported equipment, while the boost to construction activity is temporary.
items.quote_zh: 資料中心對國內經濟的外溢效果可能有限，因為它們高度倚賴進口設備，而對營建活動的拉抬只是暫時性的。

items.title: Asia Insights
items.quote: As Chinese EVs displace Japanese ICE production, the compositional shift will likely produce a net negative impact on the Thai economy.
items.quote_zh: 隨著中國電動車取代日系燃油車生產，這種組成上的位移對泰國經濟可能產生淨負面影響。

items.title: Oil Analyst_ Running Hard or Hardly Running_ Effect of Refinery Outages on Runs and Margins
items.quote: a $10/bbl rise in the US average of gasoline and diesel margins tends to boost global refinery runs by 0.6-0.8mb/d the following month
items.quote_zh: 美國汽油與柴油裂解價差的平均值每上升 10 美元／桶，往往使全球煉廠開工量在次月增加 60 萬至 80 萬桶／日。

items.title: Oil Analyst_ Running Hard or Hardly Running_ Effect of Refinery Outages on Runs and Margins
items.quote: Middle East outages remain 2mb/d above seasonal norms. Continuing drone attacks on Russian refineries keep Russian outages 3mb/d above seasonal norms.
items.quote_zh: 中東的停機量仍高於季節性常態 200 萬桶／日。對俄羅斯煉廠持續進行的無人機攻擊，使俄羅斯的停機量高於季節性常態 300 萬桶／日。

items.title: Oil Analyst_ Running Hard or Hardly Running_ Effect of Refinery Outages on Runs and Margins
items.quote: we estimate a further price upside of 50-60% in a scenario with persistent outages, and still view deferred diesel timespreads and long European natural gas positions as attractive geopolitical hedges
items.quote_zh: 在停機持續的情境下，我們估計還有 50% 至 60% 的價格上檔空間；我們仍認為遞延柴油月差與做多歐洲天然氣，是具吸引力的地緣政治對沖部位。

items.title: India Financials_ What Could Drive the Return of Private Banks_
items.quote: We believe a sustained re-rating hinges on loan growth revival to 1.5-2.0x of nominal GDP alongside improving profitability.
items.quote_zh: 我們認為，持續性的重評等取決於貸款成長回升至名目 GDP 的 1.5 至 2.0 倍，並且同時伴隨獲利能力改善。

items.title: India Financials_ What Could Drive the Return of Private Banks_
items.quote: The greater competitive risk, in our view, lies in corporate and commercial banking.
items.quote_zh: 我們認為，更大的競爭風險落在企業銀行與商業銀行業務。

items.title: India Financials_ What Could Drive the Return of Private Banks_
items.quote: Historically, attempts to move down the risk curve have often backfired during periods of macroeconomic stress.
items.quote_zh: 歷史上，往下走風險曲線的嘗試，在總體經濟承壓的期間往往都反噬。

items.title: Global Credit Trader_ IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche
items.quote: The IG non-financial market has seen over $270 billion of private placement supply year to date, which is the entire supply seen last year, and puts 2026 on track for a new record.
items.quote_zh: IG 非金融市場今年迄今已看到超過 2,700 億美元的私募供給，等於去年一整年的量，讓 2026 年有望創下新紀錄。

items.title: Global Credit Trader_ IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche
items.quote: Whereas traditionally IG private placements have been dominated by Utilities, Oil & Gas, and Autos, the last 12-months of issuance has been led by AI-related sectors.
items.quote_zh: IG 私募傳統上由公用事業、油氣與汽車主導，但過去十二個月的發行已改由 AI 相關產業領軍。

items.title: Global Credit Trader_ IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche
items.quote: We estimate approximately $2.4 trillion of USD IG bonds are currently index-ineligible due to the absence of registration rights, representing 20% of the broader USD IG market.
items.quote_zh: 我們估計目前約有 2.4 兆美元的美元 IG 債因缺少註冊權而不具指數納入資格，占整體美元 IG 市場的 20%。

items.title: Global Credit Trader_ IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche
items.quote: Notwithstanding the localized widening of the premium for AI-related issuers, the pickup in trading volumes and compression of the overall private placement premium indicate to us a growing institutional comfort and demand for this asset class.
items.quote_zh: 儘管 AI 相關發行人的溢價出現局部走闊，成交量的回升與整體私募溢價的壓縮，在我們看來顯示機構對這個資產類別的接受度與需求正在提高。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy
items.quote: In response to the oil shock, central banks have pivoted toward somewhat tighter policy. Across our panel of 27 major central banks, our forecast for policy rates has been revised higher for 17, including 175 bp higher in Brazil, 125 bp higher in Indonesia, and 100 bp higher in the UK and South Africa
items.quote_zh: 為因應油價衝擊，各國央行已轉向略為緊縮的政策。在我們追蹤的 27 家主要央行中，有 17 家的政策利率預測被上修，其中巴西上修 175 個基點、印尼 125 個基點、英國與南非各 100 個基點。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy
items.quote: If he fails to tackle these issues head on, he ultimately may be pressed to demonstrate his inflation-fighting commitment by actually hiking rates. Our reading of the macro fundamentals leaves us doubtful that rate hikes are necessary but, at some point, central bankers must act as necessary to defend their credibility.
items.quote_zh: 若他（Warsh）不正面處理這些問題，最終可能被迫以實際升息來證明自己打擊通膨的決心。我們對總體基本面的解讀讓我們懷疑升息並無必要，但在某個時點，央行官員終究必須為捍衛信譽而採取必要行動。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy
items.quote: We now see a rate hike in September and three more hikes next year that together will bring Japan’s policy rate to 2%, which is plausibly in the neighborhood of neutral
items.quote_zh: 我們現在預期九月升息一次、明年再升三次，合計將把日本政策利率帶到 2%，這大致可視為落在中性利率附近。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy
items.quote: prolonged back-and-forth in this process led us to mark-to-market for 3Q’26 to $80/bbl Brent average, with 4Q’26 remaining at $70 and 2027 at $65 Brent average.
items.quote_zh: 這個過程長期來回拉鋸，使我們把 2026 年第三季布蘭特均價按市價調整到每桶 80 美元，第四季維持 70 美元、2027 年維持 65 美元。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy
items.quote: we maintain our Overweight stance on global IT and the US. We pair these Growth exposures with O/Ws in Cyclical regions/sectors (Japan, Financials, Materials).
items.quote_zh: 我們維持對全球資訊科技與美國的加碼立場，並把這些成長型曝險與循環型區域／類股（日本、金融、原物料）的加碼搭配在一起。

items.title: Foreign Exchange Forecasts August 2026
items.quote: We lower our tactical (0-3 month) USD forecast, from 102.12 to 98.34 (raising our EURUSD forecast from 1.13 to 1.1750).
items.quote_zh: 我們把戰術性（0-3 個月）的美元預測從 102.12 下修到 98.34（歐元兌美元預測從 1.13 上調到 1.1750）。

items.title: Foreign Exchange Forecasts August 2026
items.quote: While the AI capex expansion continues (and fuels expectations for productivity gains vis-à-vis Europe), we expect the US to remain a destination for capital and a source for growth.
items.quote_zh: 只要 AI 資本支出的擴張持續（並且相對於歐洲餵養了生產力增益的預期），我們預期美國仍會是資金的目的地與成長的來源。

items.title: Foreign Exchange Forecasts August 2026
items.quote: The main cause of the yen's depreciation this year is yen-selling hedges by domestic and foreign investors, stemming from the historic rise in Japanese stock prices.
items.quote_zh: 今年日圓貶值的主因，是國內外投資人因日本股價歷史性上漲而做的賣日圓避險。

items.title: Foreign Exchange Forecasts August 2026
items.quote: A clearer sign of stress, though, remains in crack spreads as inventories for products are smaller and have been harder to maintain given refinery issues.
items.quote_zh: 不過更清楚的壓力訊號仍在裂解價差，因為成品庫存較小，而且在煉廠問題之下更難維持。

items.title: Economic Insights
items.quote: We continue to expect the Fed to remain on hold.
items.quote_zh: 我們持續預期聯準會將維持利率不變。

items.title: Economic Insights
items.quote: The election calendar provides some additional support for that call on the margin.
items.quote_zh: 選舉行事曆在邊際上為這個判斷提供了一些額外的支撐。

items.title: Economic Insights
items.quote: Our Fed forecast is premised on the inflation outlook rather than the election cycle.
items.quote_zh: 我們的聯準會預測是建立在通膨展望之上，而不是選舉週期。

items.title: Economic Insights
items.quote: June core PCE inflation slowed noticeably to 0.132% m-o-m.
items.quote_zh: 6 月核心 PCE 通膨月增率明顯放緩至 0.132%。

items.quote: We maintain our forecast that BI will hike by another 50bp in Q4, owing to balance of payments pressures likely persisting, but acknowledge uncertainty remains high.
items.quote_zh: 我們維持印尼央行第四季將再升息 50 個基點的預測，理由是國際收支壓力可能持續，但我們也承認不確定性依然很高。

items.quote: this could exacerbate BOP pressures and elicit more concerns over central bank independence, at a time when the current account deficit is set to widen again, based on our forecast.
items.quote_zh: 在我們預估經常帳赤字將再度擴大的此刻，這可能加劇國際收支壓力，並引來更多對央行獨立性的疑慮。

items.quote: We believe it also remains to be seen whether the expansion to FDI will be effective, as these are longer-term inflows that may not be sensitive to FX fluctuations.
items.quote_zh: 我們認為，把誘因擴大到外人直接投資是否有效仍有待觀察，因為那是對匯率波動未必敏感的長期資金。

items.quote: However, a CSI shock is more persistent and can sustain higher chip prices for more than the average chip upcycle of 24 months
items.quote_zh: 然而，CSI 衝擊的持續性更高，可以把較高的晶片價格維持超過 24 個月這個平均晶片上行期的長度。

items.quote: Korea supplies the constrained chip input, so changes in chip scarcity now feed directly into exports, income and liquidity via chip price surges and the trade surplus
items.quote_zh: 韓國供應的正是那個受限的晶片投入品，因此晶片稀缺程度的變化，如今會透過晶片價格飆升與貿易順差，直接傳導到出口、所得與流動性。

items.quote: A persistent bottleneck can lift the average price level and amplify the cycle, but it does not prevent the eventual downturn.
items.quote_zh: 持續性的瓶頸可以抬高平均價格水準並放大循環，但它無法阻止最終的下行。

items.title: Top of Mind_ Assessing a less transparent Fed
items.quote: Markets price what they think the Fed will do, not what they think the Fed should do.
items.quote_zh: 市場定價的是他們認為聯準會會做什麼，而不是他們認為聯準會應該做什麼。

items.title: Top of Mind_ Assessing a less transparent Fed
items.quote: I sympathize with Chairman Warsh to some extent. [But] the real problem with Warsh’s approach is his reluctance to articulate
items.quote_zh: 我在某種程度上同情 Warsh 主席。[但] 他這套做法真正的問題，在於他不願意說清楚⋯⋯（不願說明 FOMC 如何看待經濟的演變）。

items.title: Top of Mind_ Assessing a less transparent Fed
items.quote: Reducing guidance generates more volatility but also more signal...
items.quote_zh: 減少指引會製造更多波動，但也會製造更多訊號⋯⋯

items.title: Oil Monitor
items.quote: As an exercise, we project these forward, implying that OECD stockpiles could dwindle to ~70 days of
items.quote_zh: 作為一次演練，我們把這些速度往前外推，意味著 OECD 的庫存可能降到約 70 天的覆蓋水準。

items.title: Oil Monitor
items.quote: ~70 days of cover was the level reached in the Second Oil Shock of the 1970s-80s when energy spend reached ~8% of GDP, equivalent to all-in prices reaching >$200/bbl, from
items.quote_zh: 約 70 天的庫存覆蓋，是 1970–80 年代第二次石油危機時到過的水準，當時能源支出達到 GDP 的約 8%，換算成全包油價相當於每桶超過 200 美元。

items.title: Oil Monitor
items.quote: Still, while this implies tank bottoms are not as imminent on a macro total oil+products level, specific refined products (especially diesel) are already facing distress now, which could worsen further, meaning more localized,
items.quote_zh: 不過，儘管這意味著在總體原油加成品油的層面上，油缸見底沒有那麼迫在眉睫，特定的成品油（尤其是柴油）現在就已經面臨壓力，而且可能繼續惡化，意味著會出現更局部性的問題。

items.title: Oil Monitor
items.quote: While our base case remains that a deal and reopening eventually take place, penciled in for 4Q’26, where Brent could return to the $60s in 2027, our bull case recognizes that the Strait could be partially disrupted for longer, past the US midterm elections and beyond, with Brent back in the $110 range.
items.quote_zh: 我們的基準情境仍是最終達成協議並重新開放，時點暫定在 2026 年第四季，屆時 Brent 可能在 2027 年回到 60 美元區間；但我們的多頭情境認為，荷莫茲海峽可能維持部分中斷更久，越過美國期中選舉甚至更遠，Brent 會回到 110 美元一帶。

items.quote: Chair Warsh may therefore intend to use the events of the past 42 days as evidence to persuade President Trump of the need for a rate hike.
items.quote_zh: 因此 Warsh 主席可能打算把過去 42 天發生的事，當成說服川普總統需要升息的證據。

items.quote: That suggests the Fed may try to stamp out inflation even without raising the policy rate by using QT to lift long-term interest rates.
items.quote_zh: 這意味著聯準會可能不調升政策利率，而是用量化緊縮把長天期利率推高來撲滅通膨。

items.quote: the economy is strong from the perspective of AI-related industries and their shareholders, while elsewhere conditions remain quite unfavorable
items.quote_zh: 從 AI 相關產業與它們股東的角度看，經濟很強；其他地方的狀況則相當不利。

items.quote: the problem lies with the Bank of Japan’s lack of response to inflation, which needs to be promptly rectified
items.quote_zh: 問題出在日本銀行對通膨缺乏回應，這需要盡快矯正。

items.title: European Economics Analyst_ Germany—A Cyclically Loose but Structurally Tighter Labour Market
items.quote: This loosening since late 2023 primarily reflects weaker labour demand.
items.quote_zh: 2023 年底以來的這輪鬆動，主要反映的是較弱的勞動需求。

items.title: European Economics Analyst_ Germany—A Cyclically Loose but Structurally Tighter Labour Market
items.quote: Over the next decade, however, we expect labour supply to contract by about 0.4% annually, becoming a drag on growth.
items.quote_zh: 然而在未來十年，我們預期勞動供給每年將萎縮約 0.4%，成為成長的拖累。

items.title: European Economics Analyst_ Germany—A Cyclically Loose but Structurally Tighter Labour Market
items.quote: Given this contraction in labour supply, the softer labour demand implied by announced job cuts should not translate into materially higher unemployment.
items.quote_zh: 考慮到勞動供給的這種萎縮，企業宣布的裁員所隱含的較弱勞動需求，不應該轉化為明顯更高的失業率。

items.title: Global Economics Analyst_ What Has the World Learned About Central Bank Communication_
items.quote: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh aims to revise the FOMC’s communication strategy, with a goal of streamlining information and limiting forward guidance.
items.quote_zh: 聯準會主席華許意在修改 FOMC 的溝通策略，目標是精簡資訊並限縮前瞻指引。

items.title: Global Economics Analyst_ What Has the World Learned About Central Bank Communication_
items.quote: the transmission of policy surprises to our financial conditions indices (GS FCIs) is only 70% as effective for central banks at the median of the historical surprise distribution (vs. a no surprise benchmark)
items.quote_zh: 對位於歷史驚奇分布中位數的央行而言，政策驚奇傳導到我們金融條件指數（GS FCIs）的效果，只有無驚奇基準的 70%。

items.title: Global Economics Analyst_ What Has the World Learned About Central Bank Communication_
items.quote: a modest pullback in FOMC communication and transparency could bring it back in line with other major central banks without imposing significant costs. At the same time, a more significant shift away from current best practice may make monetary policy less effective.
items.quote_zh: FOMC 在溝通與透明度上溫和地往回收，可以讓它回到與其他主要央行一致的水準，而不會付出重大代價。但同時，若更大幅度地偏離目前的最佳實務，可能會讓貨幣政策的效果下降。

items.title: Power Tracker_ PJM and ERCOT_ Record Demand vs Price Divergence
items.quote: We continue to emphasize the structural tightening in PJM only modestly offset by emergency response plans, reinforcing our view of critical tightness in PJM through 2030.
items.quote_zh: 我們持續強調 PJM 的結構性趨緊，緊急應變計畫只能小幅抵銷，這強化了我們對 PJM 到 2030 年前處於臨界緊俏的看法。

items.title: Power Tracker_ PJM and ERCOT_ Record Demand vs Price Divergence
items.quote: ERCOT peak day-ahead pricing is tracking near multi-year lows (Exhibit 1) due to ample available supply, consistent with our regional divergence view that ERCOT has entered a softening path since late-2025, driven by capacity expansion efforts (especially solar and batteries) and improving real-time operational effectiveness
items.quote_zh: 由於可用供給充裕，ERCOT 的日前尖峰電價正貼近多年低點（圖表 1），這與我們的區域分歧觀點一致：ERCOT 自 2025 年底起已進入軟化路徑，動力來自容量擴建（尤其是太陽能與電池）以及即時調度效能的改善。

items.title: Power Tracker_ PJM and ERCOT_ Record Demand vs Price Divergence
items.quote: we expect this gap to reinforce the trend of new data centers favoring better-supplied regional power markets, such as ERCOT
items.quote_zh: 我們預期這道缺口會強化新建資料中心偏好供給較充裕的區域電力市場（例如 ERCOT）的趨勢。

items.title: Power Tracker_ PJM and ERCOT_ Record Demand vs Price Divergence
items.quote: On July 23, FERC held a technical conference with White House Officials and PJM stakeholders to address supply-reliability concerns, discussing measures such as breaking up PJM’s service territory and governance reform, ultimately issuing an end of September deadline to convene on solutions provided by PJM stakeholders.
items.quote_zh: 7 月 23 日，FERC 與白宮官員及 PJM 利害關係人召開技術會議，處理供給可靠度的疑慮，討論了拆分 PJM 服務區域與治理改革等措施，最後訂下 9 月底的期限，要求 PJM 利害關係人提出解方後再行商議。

items.title: Top of Mind_ IPO surge_ a red flag for markets_
items.quote: I’m less worried [about the surge in new issuance] than the average investor
items.quote_zh: 對這波發行量激增，我比一般投資人不擔心

items.title: Top of Mind_ IPO surge_ a red flag for markets_
items.quote: Historically, issuance waves paired with capex waves… have generally resulted in disappointing returns for equity holders.
items.quote_zh: 歷史上，發行浪潮疊上資本支出浪潮，對股東而言通常以令人失望的報酬收場。

items.title: Top of Mind_ IPO surge_ a red flag for markets_
items.quote: This acceleration in supply has weighed on sector spreads.
items.quote_zh: 供給加速已經壓抑了該板塊的利差表現。

items.title: Top of Mind_ IPO surge_ a red flag for markets_
items.quote: A pipeline of over 400 active applications and ample market liquidity should sustain heightened IPO activity.
items.quote_zh: 逾 400 件在審申請案與充裕的市場流動性，應能支撐居高的 IPO 活動。

items.title: Top of Mind_ An AI job apocalypse_
items.quote: that the AI transition could lead to the displacement of over 9%
items.quote_zh: 這一輪 AI 轉型可能造成超過 9% 的勞工被位移

items.title: Top of Mind_ An AI job apocalypse_
items.quote: AI is coming just as the rising tide is, but not without warning.
items.quote_zh: AI 就像正在上漲的潮水一樣會來，但不會毫無預警。

items.title: Top of Mind_ An AI job apocalypse_
items.quote: So, I expect only a small net negative impact on labor over the
items.quote_zh: 所以，我預期 AI 對勞動只會有小幅的淨負面影響

items.title: Top of Mind_ An AI job apocalypse_
items.quote: investors are not yet confident that AI-driven productivity gains
items.quote_zh: 投資人還不相信 AI 驅動的生產力增益
